theorems.name: Submission.variation_gram_det_derivatives
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ T) (A : ℝ → Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), A 0 = 1 → let j : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ Real.sqrt ((1 - T.starProjection + T.starProjection ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (A t) ∘L A t ∘L T.starProjection).det); (∀ A₁ : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, HasDerivAt A A₁ 0 → HasDerivAt j (∑ i, inner ℝ (b i : Rn N) (A₁ (b i : Rn N))) 0) ∧ ∀ A₁ A₂ : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, DifferentiableAt ℝ A t) → HasDerivAt A A₁ 0 → HasDerivAt (deriv A) A₂ 0 → HasDerivAt (deriv j) (∑ i, inner ℝ (b i : Rn N) (A₂ (b i : Rn N)) + (∑ i, inner ℝ (b i : Rn N) (A₁ (b i : Rn N))) ^ 2 + ∑ i, ‖A₁ (b i : Rn N) - T.starProjection (A₁ (b i : Rn N))‖ ^ 2 - ∑ i, ∑ k, inner ℝ (b i : Rn N) (A₁ (b k : Rn N)) * inner ℝ (b k : Rn N) (A₁ (b i : Rn N))) 0
